format: UCWDC contests, minimum entries, couples or contestants
requirement: NOT SPECIFIED IN PROVIDED SOURCE: no verified UCWDC minimum-participation rule was found. Studio's two-couple floor must not be presented as a UCWDC rule.
enforcement_point: Nothing to enforce. Any UCWDC minimum is DanceFlow or organizer policy, labelled as such.
interpretation_notes: Searched the pinned UCWDC Couples, ProPro/ProAm, Teams, Line Dance rules and the Scoring Format v16.9b (pdftotext) for: minimum, at least (two..six), fewer than, only one couple/contestant/entry, a single contestant, sole, insufficient, not enough, uncontested, unopposed, by default, walkover, cancel, combine/merge. No rule sets a minimum number of entrants for a contest to run. Hits that are NOT minimums: Couples/ProPro-ProAm/Line Dance section L (Graduation Requirements) counts a win toward graduation differently when fewer than three competitors compete for Overall (an eligibility-credit rule); Scoring Format Rule #9 item 1 mentions 'a single contestant' only for scoring points. The rules were searched by keyword, not read end to end; absence is not proof.
decision_refs: OD-21 (owner decision 2026-11-23, Option A: preserve Studio/Custom minimum-participation and withdrawal rules for initial activation; retrospective audit PR #795)
